content:
Successful HWPX template automation achieved through regex-based XML manipulation and layout cache clearing.
The process effectively handled split placeholders by applying broad regex replacements directly to XML entries within the ZIP structure. Critical layout issues were resolved by removing <hp:lineSegArray> elements to prevent viewers from displaying stale text. Final validation confirmed the removal of all '{{' patterns and the correct application of specific formatting rules for attendee counts, scores, and opinion suffixes.
